references: Previous Parts/{Name}_Parts.png and original Renewal/{Name}.png; identity and palette references only. Redraw orientation, anatomical parts and VFX.

prompts.Mushroom_Spearguard:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Redraw the referenced fantasy game character as an ANIMATION-READY CUTOUT PARTS ATLAS for a side-scrolling game.
Critical direction: character is traveling LEFT TO RIGHT, looks to the RIGHT, strict RIGHT-FACING SIDE PROFILE. Head has ONE visible near eye and a small nose/face silhouette projecting at the RIGHT edge; no front-facing two-eye face. Torso is seen from the SIDE with back on left, chest/belt buckle toward RIGHT. Boots are seen from SIDE with a pronounced rounded TOE pointing RIGHT. Rounded sturdy miniature proportions with very short legs and big head, not long human limbs.
Preserve the design identity and muted flat colors in references. Thick clean charcoal outline on CHARACTER parts, simple one-tone cel shadows, no airbrushed gradients. Draw hidden overlaps fully. All separate limb pieces hang DOWN, joint at top, boot at bottom. Upper-arm pieces are ONLY sleeves, no wrist or hand attached. Forearms are separate short bent-neutral wrist with closed mitten fist, not an open palm. Lower leg is mostly a chunky boot with a tiny bit of shin.
Layout: exactly FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows on a square genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA canvas. Sixteen isolated elements, ONE per square cell, centered with 15% padding. No labels, no text, no visible grid, no assembled character or extra copies.
Row1 left-right: [whole head with neck only, RIGHT PROFILE, no collar/body] [side-view torso ONLY, no head or limbs] [far upper-arm sleeve ONLY] [far forearm and closed fist]
Row2: [near upper-arm sleeve ONLY] [near forearm and closed gripping fist] [far short thigh] [far boot and tiny shin, TOES RIGHT]
Row3: [near short thigh] [near boot and tiny shin, TOES RIGHT] [upright complete weapon, tip at top, NO HAND] [separate accessory, NO HAND]
Row4: [thin directional attack trail] [tiny impact sparks] [small tapered projectile pointing RIGHT] [small subtle ground dust wisp]
FX DESIGN is different from body: NO BLACK OUTLINES, NO BROWN OUTLINES, NO cartoon star icon, NO opaque blobs, NO sticker appearance, NO heavy glow. Restrained slender tapered strokes with translucent edges. Trail directional and sparse; impact only 3-4 thin short rays; dust only two delicate translucent wisps. Each effect entirely isolated in its own cell.
Character specifics: Coral cap mushroom spearguard, cream face, olive short tunic and belt, chestnut boots, wooden spear with pale stone point, small olive leaf buckler. Cap leans backward left while the cream face/nose points RIGHT under its right brim. Torso narrower side profile. Head right-side silhouette, ONE eye near RIGHT edge. Weapon cell contains the entire slender spear. Accessory cell contains leaf buckler in mild perspective. FX: ivory needlelike thrust streak, three small pale gold impact rays, one small cream spore with faint trailing streak, two soft tan dust wisps.
